_about: RATIFIED Company Standard DISPUTE-VENUE-MSA-001 (AM-148, 2026-10-16) - the Legal
Constitution's own Section 22 position, quoted verbatim (sliced from the file, never
retyped). The Constitution's final text is ratified (AM-72/AM-73). CONFIGURATION:
the evaluator type it needs is added by AM-148; this file amends no locked decision.
description: Disputes are heard where our MSA places them: arbitration in Mumbai, the High Court of Mumbai appointing the arbitrator.
source_document: Leapswitch Master Services Agreement, Version 2 (July 2025) — MSA.pdf at LEGALMIND_SOURCE_MATERIAL_DIR (Sayan's MSA; same text as the approved July 2025 docx, all_lock.md AM-316)
source_quote: The courts, tribunals, councils, forums and other dispute resolution bodies in India shall have the exclusive jurisdiction to adjudicate upon any or all disputes arising out of or in connection with this Agreement. ... in the event of no consensus, then the High Court of Mumbai shall appoint an Arbitrator. ... The arbitration shall take place in Mumbai, India unless otherwise mutually agreed by the Parties and shall be conducted in the English language.

_recognised_values_note: A closed lexicon of places, not a legal position: the POSITION is allowed_values,
from the quote above. Bombay High Court is allowed because Section 22 names it for
appeals; it is matched as one phrase, so the 'bombay' inside it is never read as
Mumbai. A place not listed is simply not read - the clause then names none and
fails closed to a person (UNABLE_TO_EVALUATE), never to a match.

evaluation_rules._note: the values are read from the CONFIRMED clauses by extraction.categorical; the evaluator compares and reads no text (45D)

_terminology: Mapping terms name where a dispute is heard - a court's jurisdiction or an arbitral
seat - in the generic words contracts use; none encodes a position (rules 7/21).
_legal_rule_note: PRIYEN'S RULE (owner 'change and update', 2026-11-16; replaces the zero-tolerance ruling of 2026-08-19/20 for client changes). Better for us or no change for us is accepted without a Legal Decision; only what is worse goes to Legal. MATCH -> ACCEPTABLE; a deviation -> UNACCEPTABLE -> Legal, except a deviation on this standard's declared favourable side (favourable_direction, from a source; never with favourable_counsel_check) -> ACCEPTABLE, still a DEVIATION (AM-239). No tolerance bands. effect_rule lets a client change the engine proves better or unchanged for us be accepted automatically, audited, reopenable by Legal.

_history.source_quote_before: Standard Leapswitch/CloudPe agreements are governed by the laws of India, with courts at Pune, Maharashtra having exclusive jurisdiction. Disputes are first referred to arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996, seated in Pune and conducted in English. ... Where a High Court is referenced, the correct name is the Bombay High Court.
_history.description_before: Disputes are heard where the Constitution places them: the courts at Pune, and arbitration seated in Pune.

msa_alignment.ruling: owner, 2026-11-16: "Do not change the whole Constitution. Only change the points that differ from Sayan's MSA. Sayan's MSA is the final verdict for now — point to point use Sayan's MSA." (rule 6 approval for these lock changes; AB-205)
msa_alignment.kind: DIFFERS — the MSA standard now states Sayan's MSA
msa_alignment.note: Resolves Pune vs Mumbai for MSAs (supersedes AM-150's Pune for the MSA venue; C-27 re-opened and closed by AM-380). BOMBAY_HIGH_COURT stays allowed: 19.3's 'High Court of Mumbai' is the Bombay High Court, the name Constitution §22 says to use. PUNE is no longer an allowed value on an MSA.
